omar: Anyone else see that late swap in week 7? absolutely wild.

becka: omg yes. benching a top WR for a kicker??? smh.

ron: He9s secretly tanking for draft position i bet. :shushing_face: 

marc: also reminder: trade veto window closes in 24h. check your PMs.

ff-bot: Trade alert: marc proposed trade (marc -> becka): Give: RB J. HARRIS, Receive: WR K. NGUYEN. Veto window open until 1718543189.

becka: I voted no. Nguyen is injured and Harris is getting snaps.

omar: I voted yes. Need a WR help and Harris has been mediocre.

ron: abstain, out all weekend.

becka: if veto passes we'll re-run the matchup simulator:
```
lineup_before = [QB A, RB H, RB J, WR K, WR M, TE P, FLEX S]
lineup_after  = [QB A, RB H, RB ?, WR K, WR M, TE P, FLEX S]
```

marc: not trying to sneak anything, just want some flexibility. also btw, championship bracket is posted: https://docs.example.com/league/2023/bracket

omar: bracket looks brutal. my team faces the bye, which feels like a curse :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

ff-bot: reminder: weekly waiver claims process runs at 02:00 UTC.

becka: For morale: pizza or sushi for championship party? React with :pizza: or :sushi:.

ron: :pizza: all day.

omar: :sushi: — need something light after a long tailgate.

marc: pizza but gluten free option pls.

becka: Cool. I'll put up a poll and a Sheet for dietary prefs.

omar: also, quick line check: anyone streaming the 9pm game? link pls.

ron: http://streaming-sports.example/9pm - 40s delay, chat disabled.

becka: Thanks! I9ll hop on for the last quarter. Good luck everyone, and please don9t veto my trades unless you9re holding a time machine. :laughing:
